friction.description: Goal 1: bootstrap --brief returns all six academic deadlines, four already past, with no days-until and no window filter; the agent computes 'next three weeks' itself, against an unstated reference date.
Goal 1: project-list exposes milestone_ids, but `inspect` answers 'record not found' for all three milestones, so project dates cannot be checked through the product.

Goal 2: capture.create names its file at write time, so its revision guard is the request-scoped artifact `capture-request:<idempotency_key>` at 0. This is documented only in a code comment in tools/learning_os/contracts/gateway.py (read during S10); no doc or capability detail says so.
